ops.body:
Measured 2026-08-01 by intercepting every git call from `gt sync --no-interactive` (gt 1.8.6), and CORRECTED 2026-08-02 after a 27-run re-measurement. An earlier version of this note stated fact 3 wrongly; the correction is below.

```
GIT: fetch --no-write-fetch-head --progress --no-tags -f origin refs/heads/main:refs/gt-fetch-head/main
GIT: rev-parse refs/gt-fetch-head/main
GIT: update-ref refs/remotes/origin/main b6f3974...
GIT: merge-base --is-ancestor main b6f3974...
GIT: -C /…/gt-main-co reset -q --keep b6f3974... --
```

1. gt WRITES `refs/remotes/<remote>/<trunk>` itself from its own fetch, before it attempts to move the local branch — so the remote-tracking ref is the oracle gt itself treats as ground truth. This is why ccx vcs restack compares against it rather than the local ref. STILL TRUE.

2. gt does NOT hit gits "cannot force update the branch used by worktree" refusal, because it does not use `git branch -f`. It runs `git -C <sibling-worktree> reset -q --keep` — i.e. it hard-resets ANOTHER working copys tree without asking. On a clean sibling this SUCCEEDS and local trunk advances. STILL TRUE.

3. CORRECTED — the original claim ("gt prints ERROR: Cannot pull trunk due to conflicting unstaged changes. and STILL EXITS 0") is FALSE. Two DISTINCT messages with different exit codes were conflated:

   - `ERROR: Cannot pull trunk due to conflicting unstaged changes. ` (stderr, trailing space) fires when remote trunk IS fast-forwardable but the worktree holding trunk is dirty, so gts `reset --keep` fails. **Exit 1, universally** — 19 configurations incl. plain pipe, --no-interactive, --interactive, -q, --force, --no-restack, -d, -a, and a real PTY. Trunk never advances; no prompt is offered.
   - `WARNING: main could not be fast-forwarded.` (stderr) fires when local trunk has DIVERGED from remote — a different code path that does not go through the holder reset. **Exit 0 only when the overwrite proceeds**: `--force`, or an interactive TTY answering yes to `Overwrite main with the version from remote? (Y/n)`. Under `--no-interactive` without `--force` it is exit 1.

   ccx runs `gt sync --no-interactive` (restack.go), so BOTH land at exit 1 there and route through the error path, never the exit-0 diagnostics path.

4. STILL TRUE and separately confirmed: `Did not restack branch <b> because it is checked out in worktree <w>.` is printed to **stdout** at **exit 0** with stderr empty. That is the real exit-0-carries-meaning case, and what gtSyncSkipped correctly parses.

METHOD WARNING: `strings` on the gt binary is useless — it is a packed 86 MB Mach-O, and known-emitted strings ("Trunk set to", "Authenticated as") return zero matches. Any static-grep evidence about gts messages is void; measure by running it. Reaching the trunk-pull stage offline requires adding "owner"/"name" to .git/.graphite_repo_config (undocumented but accepted); git insteadOf rewriting does NOT work, gt reads the rewritten URL.
